subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter cluster.

MAGNET : AMNGTE :: FAMILY : AFIMYL :: BLOCKS : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• MAGNET : AMNGTE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/888bf1b9e72381580bf18bb2c6cb1cc1cab9c078b2767f3f820add5a8dd60048.png] 

and

 
• FAMILY : AFIMYL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/097edee1dfd38f3ac53c48133e9b9544cb7bda444e55c47fc9f1eaf111f1bf1b.png] 

Similarly,

 
• BLOCKS : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e07e2ca8dad44c8919c72b8e35cdb646c1429870c8bc7dc7880534c5d4135727.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"LBCOSK".**
